title: fast-serve options (fast-serve/config.json)
description: Optional options of the fast-serve dev server for SharePoint Framework 1.24.x projects. Every option is optional. Precedence: command-line flags, then this file, then config/serve.json, then the defaults. An unknown key or a wrong type stops fast-serve.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, relative to fast-serve/config.json: ../node_modules/spfx-fast-serve-helpers/schema/config.schema.json

port.description: HTTPS port of the dev server on localhost. Default: config/serve.json "port", else 4321. Flag: -p, --port.

pageUrl.description: Your SharePoint test page: when set, the start-up box also prints this page with the debug query appended. Also passed to fast-serve/rspack.extend.mjs as context.pageUrl. {tenantDomain} is replaced with the SPFX_SERVE_TENANT_DOMAIN environment variable. Default: the selected serve configuration's pageUrl, then serveConfigurations.default.pageUrl, then "initialPage" from config/serve.json (a named serve configuration's pageUrl wins over this option). Flag: --page-url.

locale.description: Locale of the localizedResources strings, with a per-resource fallback to en-us. Default: "en-us". Flag: --locale.

serveConfiguration.description: Entry of "serveConfigurations" in config/serve.json: when set, its extension query (customActions, fieldCustomizers, formCustomizer) is printed next to the web-part query. Default: "default". Flags: --config, --serve-config.

overlay.description: Show compile, runtime and type errors in an overlay over the page; false keeps them in the terminal and the browser console. Default: true. Flag: --no-overlay.

deployedLibraries.description: Package names of linked SPFx library projects to load from SharePoint (the deployed copy) instead of compiling their src. Default: []. No flag.

typeCheck.description: Type check the project in the background with its own TypeScript and tsconfig (about 1 GB of memory on large projects); results in the terminal and, unless overlay is false, in the error overlay. Default: true. Flags: --no-type-check, --type-check.

lint.description: Lint the files you save with the project's ESLint: true without type-aware rules, "full" with them, false off. Results in the terminal. Default: true. Flags: --lint, --lint full, --no-lint.
